sourceBuild.matrixCommand: moui build ios showcase --sdk iphonesimulator --mobile-config examples/showcase/moui.mobile.json
sourceBuild.evidence: installable simulator .app built from HEAD via `moui build ios --sdk iphonesimulator` + clang++ direct link (21MB, adhoc-signed), installed via simctl and launched on the iPhone 17 simulator (iOS 26.3, arm64); artifacts/ios/. NOTE: omitting --sdk iphonesimulator silently links a device-platform binary (LC_BUILD_VERSION platform=IOS) that SpringBoard rejects with 'not valid application' / launch error 163 — the simulator SDK flag is mandatory.

presenterEvidence.reference: Skia-rendered probe UI screenshots on the matching iPhone 17 simulator (iOS 26.3) through the CPU blit presenter: the runtime frame is wrapped as a CGImage and swapped into view.layer.contents (window/modules/window/ios/native_ios_host.c 'Soft present: bitmap on the main layer'); idb-driven probe interactions (tap/text/keys) render through it. The metal-direct GPU route (policy default in native_gpu_policy.mbt) is not claimed yet — the GPU seven-gate promotion stays a separate renderer item, the same standing the HarmonyOS GPU gap had at ADR 0046.

runtimeL3.evidence: Matching-simulator R6 matrix (iPhone 17, iOS 26.3; iPad Pro 11 cross-extent), 2026-11-08. All seven R6 capabilities observed. Pixels changed: Skia-rendered probe UI through the CALayer CPU blit presenter, viewport 402 x 874 reported by the probe, content reflows across the measured width. Input received: idb tap on Activate service probe -> Action count 0->1; hardware named keys (Return submits -> 'Last: Probe submit 1', Submit count 1; backspaces delete) through MBW_IOS_HOST_NAMED_KEY 16. Detach: terminate + relaunch -> fresh probe session. IME: idb text inserts at the caret through the hidden-UITextView diff adapter ('mobile-servicea-probebc-probe'). Clipboard write + read: Host services write -> 'Last: Clipboard written', host-side simctl pbpaste prints 'showcase-platform ticks=0', read -> 'Last: Clipboard read: showcase-platform ticks=0' (UIPasteboard bridge). Accessibility: the UIAccessibilityElement bridge publishes the semantics tree — idb describe-all exposes 19 nodes with labels, role traits and correct screen frames. Async image: the probe's data-URI image renders as the red square. Cross-extent: the same .app installs and runs on the iPad simulator. Evidence limitation (not an R6 capability): device rotation was not captured live — the template declares landscape orientations and the shared resize chain is verified on the sibling Android route, but every host-side rotation mechanism (System Events menus, CGEvent keystrokes, activation) is blocked by the automation host's TCC permissions; a matching-device pass can add the observation.
